description: Report a problem or gap back to the CoinPaprika MCP maintainers: call it when you got stuck, a response was unexpected, information you needed was missing, or a tool did not behave as documented. Use when the user says 'this is wrong', 'report this', 'that did not work'. Low friction, partial feedback is welcome, and every submission is read.

attempted_tools.description: OPTIONAL: List of tool names you called, in order, before submitting this feedback.

blocked_at.description: OPTIONAL: Tool name or step where you got stuck.

expected.description: OPTIONAL: What you expected to happen.

goal.description: REQUIRED: What you (or the user behind you) were trying to accomplish.

severity.description: OPTIONAL: How badly this affected your task. Default 'minor'.

name: submitFeedback

ok.description: True if the feedback row was persisted.

tracking_id.description: Stable id agents can reference in follow-up submissions; null if persistence failed.
